#!/usr/bin/env bash
# R1264r D3: ordinary lines the definition and enable -n rules once refused: a bracket expression with parens, an enable with -n later.
grep -c ' [()]' file
tr -d ' [()]' < f
sed -E 's/ [()]+//g' f
awk '{ gsub(/ [()]/, "") } 1' f
echo "to enable it: sudo visudo -n"
systemctl enable wl-x.service --no-reload -n
case "$c" in [()]) echo paren ;; esac
echo "a stub for the docs: test() { :; }"
